blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.
blocks.zh: 多标签遥感场景分类仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为空间-光谱模式复杂,阶级失衡严重,标签间依赖性往往不够完善。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一个语义-关系-跨视窗双格网(SRCWDNet),它融合了三个主要模块: (1)跨窗口关注模块,通过可学习的全球符号来捕捉本地和全球视觉环境; (2)双标签-图形模块,适应性地结合统计共聚图和已学习的语义-嵌入图,以便于标签-关系推理; (3)神经分类链,依次预测标签,以利用标签间依赖性. SRCWDNet利用5倍的交叉验证并经过非对称-Graph-Consistency损失培训,实现了98.93%和96.53%的速率,在MLRSNet和China-MAS50k数据集上相应的F1分数分别为0.9365和0.8723,均优于CNN,变压器和轻量基线. 这些研究结果表明,联合建模视觉关注度和适应性标签相关性可以大大改进多标签遥感场景分类,特别是在长尾类分布下.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: With the advent of modern earth observation programs, images are acquired at a scale which has revolutionized environmental monitoring, urban planning and disaster management [ 1 ] . Copernicus Sentinel-2 mission was developed to provide systematic, high revisit multi-spectral observations over the Earth’s land surface for operational services [ 1 ] . It is rare for a single high-resolution scene to show only a single land-cover type, as croplands, roads and settlements typically are all present within the same tile [ 2 ] . Having both of these co-occur renders single label scene classification over-simplified reality as it pertains to ground conditions [ 3 ] . The large scale land-cover reference products such as Coordination of Information on the Environment (CORINE) and Global Land Cover 2000 (GLC2000) confirm that multi-class and heterogeneous land parcels are not an exception, but the rule worldwide [ 4 ] . To compensate, the MLRSNet benchmark has been created with 109,161 images, 46 scene categories, each of which is assigned multiple labels from 60 predefined classes [ 2 ] . Thus, the multi-label recognition of such imagery is a key element in large scale land use mapping and evidence-based environmental decision making [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着现代地球观测方案的出现,图像的获取规模使环境监测、城市规划和灾害管理发生了革命性的变化。 哥白尼哨兵-2号任务是为了对地球地面进行系统、高频谱观测,以提供业务服务。 单一的高分辨率场景很少显示单一的土地覆盖类型,因为耕地、道路和定居点通常都位于同一瓦片内。 由于这两种共聚物使单一标签的场景分类过于简单化,因为它与地面条件有关。 大规模的土地覆盖参考产品,如环境信息协调(CORINE)和2000年全球土地覆盖物(GLC2000),证实多阶级和多样性的地块并非例外,而是全世界的规则[4]。 为补偿起见,MLRSNet基准已经创建了109,161个图像,46个场景类别,每个场景类别都被从60个预定义的类别[2]中指定了多个标签. 因此,这些图像的多标签识别是大规模土地利用测绘和循证环境决策的一个关键要素[5]。

blocks.en: Early multi-label remote sensing systems were based on hand-crafted descriptors in combination with classical learners like Support Vector Machines [ 6 ] . Land-cover characterization tasks were also carried out using ensemble learners, like Random Forests [ 7 ] . A few problem-transformation approaches were adopted to transform the multi-label problem into correlated binary sub-problems, such as Multi-Label K-Nearest Neighbor (ML-kNN) [ 8 ] . Classifier Chains followed this trend by explicitly carrying over the previously predicted classes into subsequent predictions [ 9 ] . Later, multi-label remote sensing scenes were addressed by introducing structured and spatial Support Vector Machine (SVM) formulations in order to learn the inter-label structure [ 10 ] . These pipelines are mostly based on the theory of multi-label learning, which includes the original scene-classification formulation of Boutell et al. [ 3 ] . A more thorough survey of multi-label learning algorithms also identified the advantages and disadvantages of these problem-transformation and algorithm-adaptation approaches [ 11 ] . In practice, however, these approaches rely on manually designed, low-level features that are not able to describe the subtle spatial and spectral diversity of remote sensing scenes [ 10 ] . They also have poor scalability because of the increasing number of labels and model label dependence poorly [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的多标签遥感系统是以手工制作的描述符为基础,与支持矢量机等古典学习者结合[6]. 土地覆盖特征鉴定任务也利用群集学习者来执行,如随机森林[7]。 采取了一些问题转换方法,将多标签问题转变为相互关联的二进制子问题,如多标签K-近邻(ML-kNN)[8]. 分类链遵循了这一趋势,将先前预测的类别明确纳入随后的预测[9]。 后来,通过引入结构化和空间支持矢量机(SVM)配体来研究多标签遥感场景,以学习标签间结构[10]. 这些管道大多基于多标签学习理论,其中包括布特尔等人最初的场景分类配方. [3]. 对多标签学习算法进行更彻底的调查,也发现了这些问题转换和算法适应方法的利弊[11]. 然而在实践中,这些方法依赖于人工设计的低层特征,无法描述遥感场景微妙的空间和光谱多样性[10]. 由于标签和模型标签依赖越来越多,它们的可扩展性也很差[11]。

blocks.en: To achieve end-to-end feature learning, deep learning took the field, as reported in a technical tutorial [ 12 ] that is widely cited in the field of remote sensing analysis using CNNs. The application of multi-label Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) image classification was extended, and dedicated deep architectures were used for this [ 13 ] . The pipelines of sparse-autoencoder and multi-attention K-Branch Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) were presented for the multi-label classification of spatio-spectral cues [ 14 ] . For specific application of CNNs to multi-label land-cover scene categorization, data-augmentation techniques were used [ 15 ] . Later, multi-label aerial images were addressed by introducing attention-augmented CNN–BiLSTM frameworks that make use of class-wise dependencies. A relation network formulation was also developed to model pairwise label relations for multi-label aerial image classification [ 16 ] . For multi-label remote sensing retrieval, explicit modeling of label co-occurrence was proposed using graph-theoretic formulations [ 17 ] . Motivated by this, the authors of [ 18 ] integrated Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with CNN backbones to model spatio-topological label relationships in scene classification. For multi-label remote sensing classification and retrieval, a dedicated Graph Relation Network was also built to model the inter-scene and inter-label relations [ 19 ] . For classification purposes, a label-driven graph convolutional formulation was proposed to better utilize the existing label correlation [ 20 ] . Small, scattered objects in multi-label scenes have been tackled by introducing global context-based multilevel feature fusion networks [ 21 ] . Vision Transformers have also been used to improve global context modeling in scene classification for remote sensing data [ 22 ] over convolutional backbones only. A semantic relation inference approach based on a transformer model was presented to reason about both spatial context and label relations simultaneously [ 23 ] . To overcome the huge class imbalance commonly found in multi-label remote sensing archives, dedicated loss functions were introduced that include label co-occurrence weighting [ 24 ] . Yet, currently available graph-based methods remain mostly based on static or purely co-occurrence based adjacency, and few combine the two with model-based semantic similarity [ 19 ] , [ 20 ] . Most frameworks only focus on the local detail or global context, not on both at once [ 22 ] , [ 21 ] . Label-dependency and imbalance-aware losses are, in turn, usually considered as add-ons, not as part of the network itself [ 24 ] . These gaps inspire an architecture that unifies cross-scale attention, adaptive label-relation graphs and correlation-aware sequential prediction in one trainable pipeline [ 19 ] , [ 20 ] , [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了实现端到端的特征学习,深层学习攻占了这个领域,如在利用CNN的遥感分析领域被广泛引用的技术教程[12]所报道的那样. 多标签无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)图像分类的应用被扩展,并使用专用的深层建筑来进行这个[13]. 稀疏自动编码器和多管K-Branch进化神经网络(CNN)的管线被提出来用于斯皮提奥光谱提示的多标签分类[14]. 为了将CNN用于多标签土地覆盖场景分类,采用了数据采集技术[15]。 后来,多标签的空中图像通过引入利用类依赖性的CNN-BILSTM框架来解决。 还开发了一种关系网络配方,为多标签航空图像分类[16]建立双向标签关系模型。 关于多标签遥感检索,建议使用图定理论配体对标签进行明确的模型化[17]。 以此为动机,[18]集成图神经网络(GNNs)与CNN骨干网的作者在场景分类中建模斯皮提欧-地形标记关系. 为多标签遥感分类和检索,还建立了一个专用的图象关系网,以模拟场间关系和标签间关系[19]. 为分类目的,建议采用由标签驱动的图解式配方,以更好地利用现有的标签关联性[20]. 多标签场景中分散的小型物体已经通过引入基于全球背景的多层次特性聚变网络来解决. [21]. 愿景 变形器还被用于改进遥感数据场景分类的全球背景模型[22],仅次于演化骨干. 基于变压器模型的语义关系推论方法被提出来说明空间上下文和标签关系同时[23]. 为了克服在多标签遥感档案中常见的巨大等级不平衡,引入了专门的损失功能,其中包括标签共效加权[24]. 然而,目前可用的基于图表的方法大多仍然是基于静态或纯粹基于共发的辅音,很少将两者与基于模型的语义相似性结合[19],[20]. 大多数框架只注重地方细节或全球背景,而不是同时注重两者。 标签依赖性和对不平衡的认识损失反过来通常被视为附加,而不是网络本身的一部分[24]. 这些空白激发了一种将跨尺度关注,适应性标签-关系图和关联-意识相继在一个可训练管线上预测的架构[19],[20],[23].

blocks.en: To address this, we present a novel approach of multi-label remote sensing classification based on a cross-window dual-graph network with semantic-relational reasoning (SRCWDNet) [ 2 ] , [ 5 ] . A convolutional backbone extracts hierarchical features and a Cross-Window Attention module refines features by learnable global tokens, which effectively integrates local detail and scene-level context inspired by the transformer-based global reasoning [ 22 ] . A Dual Label-Graph module combines a statistical co-occurrence prior with a learned label-embedding similarity graph, building on previous static-graph label reasoning approaches [ 16 ] , [ 26 ] . The labels are then predicted sequentially by a Neural Classifier Chain, which is a new extension of classical classifier-chain theory to an end-to-end differentiable deep setting [ 9 ] . The training consists of an asymmetric loss function based on the rationale of co-occurrence-weighted multi-label remote sensing losses [ 17 ] combined with a graph-consistency term that forces the prediction to be consistent with the learned label graph [ 19 ] . The overall design is also inspired by multi-attention evidence that spatial and spectral cues are better modeled together than separately [ 14 ] . The framework is validated with k-fold cross-validation on the MLRSNet [ 2 ] and China-MAS-50k benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种以跨窗口双图网络为基础的多标签遥感分类的新办法,其中包含语义-关系推理(SRCWDNet)[2][5]。 演化骨干提取分级特征 跨视窗关注模块通过可学习的全球标志来完善特征,有效整合了基于变压器的全球推理启发的局部细节和场景级背景[22]. 双标签-图形模块结合了之前的统计共聚体和学习过的标签-嵌入式相似性图,借鉴了之前的静态图标签推理方法[16],[26]. 标签随后由神经分类链依次预测,这是古典分类链理论向端到端可异的深层设置的新延伸[9]. 培训包括一种不对称损失功能,其依据是共发生加权多标签遥感损失[17],加上一个图一致性术语,迫使预测与所学标签图一致[19]. 总体设计还受到多种注意力的启发,即空间和光谱提示比单独[14]更好的模型组合. 该框架通过在MLRSNet[2]和China-MAS-50k基准上的k倍交叉验证得到验证.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: • The Cross-Window Attention module that combines local spatial detail and global scene context by learning global tokens, which overcomes the local/global trade-off found in transformer-based remote sensing classifiers. • The Dual Label-Graph reasoning module adaptively combines the statistical co-occurrence of labels and learned semantic label embeddings by gating the graph, resolving the static-graph problem of previous graph-based multi-label remote sensing classifiers. • The Neural Classifier Chain, a head modeling inter-label dependency for frequency-ordered sequential prediction, which extends classical classifier chains to an end-to-end differentiable deep learning setting.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: •通过学习全球符号,将本地空间细节和全球场景环境结合起来的跨窗口关注模块,它克服了变压器遥感分类器中发现的本地/全球权衡. • 支助 Dual Label-Graph 推理模块通过对图表进行加注,以适应性的方式结合了标签和已学习的语义标记嵌入的统计共聚性,解决了之前基于图表的多标签遥感分类器的静态图解问题. ^ 神经分类链(英語:Neural Classifier chain),是用于频率排序顺序预测的标签间依赖性的头型模型,它将古典分类链扩展至端对端的深层学习设置.

blocks.zh: 横窗 注意模块,通过学习全球符号,结合地方空间细节和全球场景背景,克服了变压器遥感分类器中发现的地方/全球权衡.

blocks.en: II Literature Review
blocks.zh: 二. 文学评论

blocks.en: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification (MLRSSC) has evolved from the traditional attention-based CNNs to the graph-relational networks, transformer-based relation inference, and single-positive weak supervision, and also to the latest density-aware, Mamba-based and scene-aware frameworks. In this section, we list the most direct works, in order of presentation, and indicate the specific limitations which led to the design of SRCWDNet.
blocks.zh: 多标签遥感场景分类(MLRSSC)已经从传统的以关注为主的CNN演化为图关系网络,变压器关系推论,单阳性弱监督,以及最新的密度感知,曼巴和场景感知框架. 在本节中,我们按编排顺序列出最直接的作品,并说明导致设计SRCWDNet的具体限制。

blocks.en: Liu et al. [ 25 ] introduced a model called AdaGC for single-positive multi-label learning (SPML) in remote sensing, where only one positive label is labeled for a single image while the model is required to predict the entire set of labels. Under random and dominant single-positive noise, AdaGC achieves state-of-the-art mAP on reBEN and AID, which utilizes a Gradient Calibration mechanism and a dual exponential-moving-average student-teacher pseudo-labeling scheme along with a theoretically grounded early learning detection indicator to adaptively trigger the calibration. But AdaGC is not about architectural label-correlation modeling; it is about missing-label supervision noise, and it uses a plain classification head (no statistical-semantic label graph) and no sequential/autoregressive prediction.
blocks.zh: 刘等. [25] 在遥感中引入了一个名为AdaGC的单阳性多标签学习(SPML)模型,其中只有一个正性标签被标注为单一图像,而模型则需要预测整个一组标签. 在随机和占主导地位的单阳性噪声下,AdaGC在ReBEN和AID上实现了最先进的mAP,它利用梯度校准机制和双指数移动-平均学生-教师假标签计划,以及理论基础的早期学习检测指标来适应性地触发校准. 但是,AdaGC并不是关于建筑标签-orrelation建模;而是关于缺少标签的监督噪声,它使用一个简单的分类头(没有统计-语义标签图),没有顺序/自动递减的预测.

blocks.en: Using multi-label learning, Sharifi et al. [ 26 ] presented a lightweight ResNet50 based multi-label approach for coastal land-use mapping by fusing multiple spectral, spatial and textural descriptors of features from various sensors at the feature level and testing on MLRSNet coastal categories (wetland, water, ship, sea, river, lake, island, beach). It achieved an F1-score of 0.944 with only 114K parameters compared to SVM/RF (0.81/0.84) and DenseNet121 (0.93 at 8.2M parameters), and Grad-CAM showed that the network focuses on the sand-water interfaces and vegetated patches in an appropriate way. It is all based on simple feature level fusion, does not use any explicit label-relation graph or attention based reasoning between co-occurring classes, and still misclassifies similar classes such as beach/wetland and river/lake that are similar in visual appearance, which is exactly what our Dual Label-Graph module aims to resolve.
blocks.zh: 使用多标签学习,Sharifi等人. [26] 介绍了以轻量级的ResNet50为基础的沿海土地利用绘图多标签办法,方法是在特征一级使用各种传感器的特征的多谱、空间和文字描述符,并对MLRSNet沿海类别(湿地、水、船舶、海、河、湖、岛屿、海滩)进行测试。 它实现了0.944的F1-分数,与SVM/RF(0.81/0.84)和DenseNet121(8.2M参数为0.93)相比,只有114K的参数,Grad-CAM显示网络以适当方式注重沙水接口和植被补丁. 它都基于简单的特征级聚变,不使用任何明显的标签关系图或基于注意力的共发生类之间的推理,仍然错误分类类似类,如海滩/湿地和河/湖在视觉外观上相似,这正是我们的双标签-Graph模块所要解决的.

blocks.en: Du et al. [ 27 ] introduced MLMamba, which introduced the pyramid Mamba (multi-scale bidirectional state-space scanning for global context) and the feature-guided semantic modeling (FGSM) Mamba that reasons over BERT-derived label embeddings guided by visual cues, running at linear O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) complexity. Compared to the Transformer-based ones, MLMamba has just 13.44M parameters and 2.43G FLOPs and achieves state-of-the-art mAP on UCM-ML and DFC15-ML. It does not adaptively combine a learned statistical co-occurrence prior with its pretrained embeddings for the labels, however; and its relation reasoning is a single forward/backward pass, not the gated dual-source graph with sequential dependency at the decision level that our Dual Label-Graph and Neural Classifier Chain provide. There are two recent hierarchical works that inspire our label-relation design.
blocks.zh: 杜等编. [27] 引入了MLMamba,它引入了金字塔Mamba(全球背景的双向双向状态-空间扫描)和特征导语义模型(FGSM)Mamba,其原因是比BERT派生的标签嵌入有视觉提示,运行在线性O ⁡(n) O(n)复杂度. 与基于变形器的MLMamba相比,它只有13.44M参数和2.43G FLOP,并在UCM-ML和DFC15-ML上实现了最先进的mAP. 然而,它不适应性地将一个在标签上预先训练好的嵌入之前就已经学习过的统计共聚体结合起来;它的关系推理是单一的前向/后向传承,而不是我们双重标签-图形和神经分类链提供的决策层次上具有连续依次依赖性的门式双源图表。 最近有两部分级作品启发了我们的标签关系设计.

blocks.en: To achieve state-of-the-art performance on UCM, AID, DFC-15 and MLRSNet, in particular in the low-label regime, HELM [ 28 ] employs a self-supervised branch on top of hierarchy-specific ViT class tokens and GCNs. MAPLE [ 29 ] achieves up to +42% improvement in the few-shot regime on CORINE-aligned AID/DFC-15/MLRSNet with just 2.6% of model parameters compared to the other state-of-the-art. The two, however, rely on a clear multi-path taxonomy and auxiliary text/self-supervised signals and do not perform label-graph reasoning or link a correlation-aware autoregressive head, which is what our Neural Classifier Chain does.
blocks.zh: 为了在UCM,AID,DFC-15和MLRSNet上实现最先进的性能,特别是在低标签制度下,HELM[28]在等级特异的ViT类标志和GCN上使用一个自我监督的分支. MAPLE [29] 在CORINE-accessed AID/DFC-15/MLRSNet上的几发投影制式上取得了高达+42%的改进,相比其他最先进的模型参数只有2.6%. 然而,两者依赖于一个清晰的多路径分类学和辅助文本/自我监督的信号,不进行标签-图推理或连接一个具有相关性的自递性头,这就是我们的神经分类链所做的.

blocks.en: Du et al. [ 30 ] proposed S2L2-Net, which contains a Scene Perception Module that adaptively learns a latent scene per image (without scene annotation), then maintains a scene-to-label probability matrix, which is then used to condition a transformer-based Semantic Relationship Interaction Module to re-weight label semantics. It provides better performance than SNDL-BCE, SR-Net, BoostLU, SALGL and SGRE on UCM-ML, AID-ML and DFC15-ML. There are, however, two important differences: (1) label relationships are conditioned on only a single inferred discrete scene, and (2) prediction is a set of independent binary classifiers, without sequential conditioning between labels, both of which our Dual Label-Graph and Neural Classifier Chain address.
blocks.zh: 杜等编. [30] 提议的S2L2-Net,它包含一个场景感知模块,每个图像都适应性地学习一个潜在场景(没有场景注释),然后维持一个场景到标签概率矩阵,然后用来对基于变压器的语义关系互动模块进行条件化,以重新加权标记语义. 它在UCM-ML,AID-ML和DFC15-ML上提供比SNDL-BCE,SR-Net,BoostLU,SALGL和SGRE更好的性能. 然而,有两种重要的区别:(1)标签关系仅以单个推断的离散场景为条件,(2)预测是一组独立的二进制分类器,在标签之间没有顺序的限定,两者都是我们的双标签-Graph和神经分类链地址.

blocks.en: Mudraje et al. [ 31 ] compared image Super-Resolution (SRResNet, HAT, SeeSR, RealESRGAN) with multi-label classification (ResNet-50/101/152, Inception-v4) on BigEarthNet, and concluded that attention-based SR (HAT) worked best with the deep backbones while generative SR (SeeSR, RealESRGAN) could “hallucinate” details and damage some classes, and that all SR variants performed better than the no-SR baseline in terms of accuracy, Hamming loss, F1, and Macro-F2. This is a purely input resolution enhancement study, though—it does not involve model architecture, label-correlation modeling, or attention over feature maps, where our Cross-Window Attention and Dual Label-Graph modules operate instead.
blocks.zh: Mudraje等人[31]将图像超分辨率(SRResNet、HAT、SeeSR、RealESRGAN)与大地球网上的多标签分类(ResNet-50/101/152、Inception-v4)相比较,并得出结论,基于注意力的SR(HAT)对深层骨干最有效,而基因的SR(SESR、RealESRGAN)可以“吸附”细节并损害某些类别,所有SR变体在准确性、Hamming损失、F1和Macro-F2方面都表现优于无SR基线。 这是一个纯粹的输入分辨率增强研究,虽然——它不涉及模型架构,标签-对映模型,或者在特征图上引起注意,我们跨窗口的注意力和双标签-图形模块在那里运行。

blocks.en: Ragab [ 32 ] suggested MSCRSI-MDODL, which consists of an SE-attention-augmented DenseNet backbone, a hyperparameter tuning method based on a Modified Dingo Optimizer (MDO) metaheuristic, and classification based on a stacked dilated convolutional autoencoder (DCAE), yielding 99.88% accuracy and 1.80 s computational time on the UC Merced LandUse set compared to several deep-transfer-learning baselines. Dual Label-Graph and Neural Classifier Chain are designed to close the gaps left open by this single-label 21-class scene classification method, which was learned using metaheuristic hyperparameter search and yet does not account for any inter-label co-occurrence, cross-scale attention, or sequential dependency.
blocks.zh: Ragab[32]建议MSCRSI-MDODL,它包括一个SE-attention-augenseNet主干线,一个基于Modified Dingo Optimeuristic(MDO)元器件的超参数调制方法,以及一个堆积的膨胀式自动编码器(DCAE)的分类,与几个深层转移-学习基线相比,UC Merced Land Usesers集的精度为99.88%,计算时间为1.80。 双标签图形和神经分类符 链是用来关闭这种单标签21级场景分类法所留下的空白的,这种方法是通过元论超参数搜索而学到的,然而却不计入任何标签间共聚,跨尺度的注意,或顺序依赖.

blocks.en: Du et al. [ 33 ] introduced SFIN, which consists of a dual-scale feature extractor (taking the last two residual units of ResNet18), a Local Semantic Enhance Module using cross-attention between feature pixels and class-attention map-derived semantics, a Cross-Scale Interactive Attention Module fusing the two scales, and a semantic supervision loss and a semantic-level contrastive loss that pushes/pulls apart the same/different-label embeddings in feature space. On the UCM-ML, AID-ML, DFC15-ML and MLRSNet datasets, SFIN obtains state-of-the-art results. Yet, its semantic connections are only constructed based on attention to the given image’s class-activation vectors, and its classification head is neither sequential nor dependent across the training set, as is specifically targeted by our Dual Label-Graph (statistical plus semantic fusion) and Neural Classifier Chain (sequential conditioning).
blocks.zh: 杜等编. [33] 引入了SFIN,它包括一个双级特征提取器(取ResNet18的最后两个剩余单元),一个局部语义增强模块,在特征像素和类意向地图派生语义之间进行交叉注意,一个跨比例交互式注意模块,使两个尺度相互连接,以及一个语义监督损失和一个语义水平对比性损失,将同一/不同的标签嵌入在特征空间中分开。 在UCM-ML,AID-ML,DFC15-ML和MLRSNet数据集上,SFIN获得最新结果. 然而,它的语义连接只是基于对给定图像的类活性向量的注意而构建的,它的分类头既不是顺序的,也不是整个训练集的依赖性的,正如我们的双标签加语义聚变(Statistical + semantic culture)和神经分类链(sevical conservation)所特别针对的那样.

blocks.en: You et al. [ 34 ] proposed DenseNet121-CBAM, which combines a densely connected CNN with the Convolutional Block Attention Module and uses a sigmoid instead of a softmax head for multi-label classification. The method outperformed DenseNet121 by 1.2% subset accuracy on multi-source SEN12MS and reached 0.92 micro-F1 on UC-Merced. However, channel and spatial attention is applied only at the feature-extraction stage and each label is predicted independently at the head, while inter-label co-occurrence is not modeled at all—one of the authors’ explicit points of future work, which we directly target with our Dual Label-Graph module.
blocks.zh: 汝等诸人. [34] 提出了DenseNet121-CBAM,它将一个连接稠密的CNN与Convolutional Block Reference模块结合,并使用一个sigmoid而不是软max头用于多标签分类. 该方法在多源SEN12MS上以1.2%的子集精度超过DenseNet121,在UC-Merced上达到0.92微F1. 然而,频道和空间注意力只在特征采集阶段使用,每个标签在头部是独立的预测,而标签之间的共发生则完全没有建模 -- -- 作者未来工作的明确点之一,我们直接以我们的双标签-格拉夫模块为目标。

blocks.en: Ma et al. [ 35 ] introduced DARC, a lightweight framework that routes multi-label prediction through a dense or sparse calibration profile based on the density of the labels in the training set, which consists of a Correlative-Discriminative Graph Mixing module (jointly encoding positive co-occurrence and negative exclusivity) and density-aware gated calibration. It achieves an F1 score of 90.12% on AID-ML and 89.05% on UCM-ML, outperforming six strong baselines by 1.65–3.87%, with only 1.42% parameter overhead. The calibration is done after the fact on a fixed base encoder’s logits, however; it is not integrated into the visual feature pathway and it does not model sequential inter-label dependency at the decision level. This is where our Neural Classifier Chain comes in.
blocks.zh: Ma et al. [35]引入了DARC,一个轻量级框架,根据训练集中标签的密度,通过密集或稀疏的校准剖面来引导多标签预测,它包括一个相关-差别图混合模块(联合编码正共聚和负排他性)和密度-知门校准. 它在AID-ML和UCM-ML上分别取得了90.12%和89.05%的F1分,比6个强基线高出1.65–3.87%,只有1.42%的参数在间接费用上. 然而,校准是在固定编码器的对数上完成的;它没有融入视觉特性路径,也没有在决策一级模拟连续的标签间依赖。 这是我们的神经分类链进入的地方。

blocks.en: Lv and Wu [ 36 ] introduced a lightweight network (SDRCNet) that enhances boundary, directional and regional structural cues by applying a Structural Detail Enhancement block, correlates labels across scene, detail and region granularities, and reasons over category correlation and category competition using an evidence-aware dual-relation module. It has achieved 79.3% mAP and 83.7% OF1 on China-MAS-50k with just 1.13 GFLOPs and 3.82M parameters, while boosting mAP from 64.8% to 70.5% on MultiScene-Clean. Unlike our Dual Label-Graph module, it does not sequentially condition later label predictions on previous ones, or gate-fuse a learned semantic-embedding graph with empirical co-occurrence statistics; it uses a single fixed regional-query pass per image.
blocks.zh: Lv和Wu [36] 引入了轻量级网络(SDRCNet),通过应用结构细节增强块来增强边界,方向和区域结构提示,在场景,细节和区域颗粒之间关联标签,以及使用证据意识双相关模块来说明类别关联和类别竞争的原因. 它在中国-MAS-50k上实现了79.3%的mAP和83.7%的OF1,只有1.13 GFLOP和3.82M参数,同时在多层层清洁上将mAP从64.8%提升到70.5%. 与我们的双标签-图形模块不同的是,它不按顺序对先前的预测进行标记,也不使用带有经验共聚性统计的有学问的语义混合图;它使用每个图像的单个固定区域-结晶通道。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 概览

blocks.en: The proposed model is named SRCWDNet (Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-graph Network), which is a hierarchical model for multi-label classification of remote sensing scenes. There are five key architectural modules. The first is a ConvNeXt-Base backbone which is responsible for extracting the hierarchical convolutional features of the input scene, with the first two stages of the network being frozen to maintain generic low-level ImageNet statistics. Next, a Cross-Window Attention (CWA) module is applied to the extracted feature map which provides a small number of learnable global tokens, exchanging information with each spatial location in two passes: once to gather the global context into the tokens, followed by an output pass to broadcast the tokens back to each spatial position, providing the backbone with a global receptive field without the quadratic expense of self-attention.
blocks.zh: 提议的模型命名为SRCWDNet(Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Tual-graphy Network),是遥感场景多标签分类的分级模型. 共有五个关键的建筑模块. 第一种是ConvNEXt-Base主干线,负责提取输入场景的分级演化特征,网络的前两个阶段被冻结,以维持通用的低级ImageNet统计. 接下来,一个跨窗口关注(CWA)模块被应用到提取的功能图中,该功能图提供了少量可学习的全球信使,与每个空间位置在两个路由中交换信息:一次是将全球背景收集到信使中,然后是输出传回每个空间位置广播信使,为主干提供了全局可接受的字段,没有自觉的四倍成本.

blocks.en: The refined map is then compressed in parallel by Global Average Pooling and Global Max Pooling, and the resulting embedding is fed into a Dual Label-Graph (DLG) module that integrates a statistical co-occurrence matrix of labels with a learned semantic embedding graph through a learnable gate per edge, and then adds the label-relational context back to the visual embedding by cross-attention. Finally, a Neural Classifier Chain (NCC) predicts the K K class labels in descending order of training-set frequency, each prediction depending on all previously predicted labels. Fig. 1 shows the proposed methodology.
blocks.zh: 精制版的地图随后被Global Eural Pooling和Global Max Pooling同步压缩,由此产生的嵌入被输入到一个双标签-Graph(DLG)模块中,该模块通过每个边缘的可学习门将一个具有学识的语义嵌入图的标签统计共聚矩阵整合起来,然后将标签-关系上下文添加到视觉嵌入中. 最后,一个神经分类链(NCC)按照训练-设置频率的降序来预测K类标签,每个预测都取决于所有先前预测的标签. 图1显示了拟议方法。

blocks.en: The DLG module models inter-label dependency by constructing a dynamic graph over the class label set, fusing a statistical co-occurrence prior with a learned semantic-embedding graph, rather than relying on either signal alone. blocks.en: IV Datasets
blocks.zh: 四. 数据集

blocks.en: IV-A MLRSNet [ 37 ]
blocks.zh: 四-A MLRSNet [37]

blocks.en: Instead of only a single flyover campaign, MLRSNet was built from high-resolution optical satellite and aerial imagery from Google Earth and other open source data sources across a broad spectrum of geographic regions and land-cover conditions. The image resolution is 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels with three RGB spectral bands, and the spatial resolution ranges from 10 m to 0.1 m/pixel. It contains 109,161 labeled images divided into 46 scene categories and labeled with up to 60 predefined semantic labels; each image has between 1 and 13 labels.
blocks.zh: MLRSNet不是只开展一次飞越活动,而是利用Google Earth和其他开源数据来源的高分辨率光学卫星和航空图像,在广泛的地理区域和土地覆盖条件下建立。 图像分辨率为256×256\times 256像素,具有3个RGB光谱波段,空间分辨率范围为10米至0.1米/像素. 它包含109,161个标签的图像,分为46个场景类别,并贴上多达60个预定义的语义标签;每个图像都有1到13个标签.

blocks.en: IV-B China-MAS-50k [ 38 ]
blocks.zh: IV-B China-MAS-50k [38] (英语).

blocks.en: The China Multi-label dataset for Agriculture and Rural Scenes (China-MAS-50k) was compiled by systematically sampling more than 50,000 points on the Chinese agricultural and rural landscape over the entire country on a 50 km grid, followed by a cross-checked and error-corrected visual interpretation procedure using very-high-resolution (VHR) Google Earth imagery at each point. The imagery is not collected during a dedicated airborne hyperspectral or optical-sensor campaign, but is derived from existing VHR satellite basemaps. It contains 55,520 labeled VHR images with 135,289 labels in total, belonging to 18 fine-grained categories, including cropland, woodland, grassland, rural village, factory building, greenhouse, photovoltaic station, solid waste, plastic mulch, dust-proof net, park, river, lake/pond, bare land, railway, and road. Fig. 8 shows dataset images with their labels.
blocks.zh: 中国农业与农村场景多标签数据集(China-MAS-50k)是通过50公里网格对全国的中国农业和农村地貌5万多点进行系统取样,然后采用甚高分辨率(VHR)Google地球影像进行交叉检查和校正的视觉判读程序. 图像不是在专门的空中超光谱或光学传感器运动中收集的,而是从现有的甚高分辨率卫星基图中得出的。 它包含55,520张标有135,289个标签的VHR图像,属于18个精细的类别,包括耕地、林地、草地、乡村、工厂建筑、温室、光伏站、固体废物、塑料泥浆、防尘网、公园、河流、湖泊/池塘、裸露的土地、铁路和公路。 图8显示了带有其标签的数据集图像.

blocks.en: V-A Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table II presents the classification performance of SRCWDNet on MLRSNet and China-MAS-50k. On MLRSNet the model has a micro-accuracy of 0.9893, Cohen’s Kappa/MCC of ∼ \sim 0.946 and a low Hamming loss (0.0107) due to the balanced distribution of the labels. On the more imbalanced China-MAS-50k, performance is still satisfactory (F1 = 0.8723, specificity = 0.9721), but Kappa/MCC is lower ( ∼ \sim 0.769) as agreement is weaker on long-tailed minority classes such as dust-proof nets and photovoltaic stations. Both datasets have a Failure Rate around 42–43%, indicating that the exact-match, high-cardinality multi-label setting is challenging. This high accuracy and label-relational reasoning is achieved through the joint action of the Cross-Window Attention module, the Dual Label-Graph module and the Neural Classifier Chain module.
blocks.zh: 表二列示了SRCWDNet在MLRSNet和China-MAS-50k上的分类性能. 在MLRSNet上,该型号的微精度为0.9893,Cohen的Kappa/MCC为\sim 0.946,由于标签的均衡分布,哈明损失较低(0.0107)。 在比较不平衡的China-MAS-50k上,性能仍然令人满意(F1 = 0.8723,特异性= 0.9721),但Kappa/MCC则较低(\\sim 0.769),因为对于防尘网和光伏站等长尾少数民族类别的协议较弱. 这两套数据集的故障率都在42–43 %左右,表明精确匹配的高心率多标签设置具有挑战性. 这种高精度和标签-关系推理是通过跨窗口关注模块,双标签-Graph模块和神经分类链模块的联合行动实现的.

blocks.en: V-B Computational Complexity Comparison
blocks.zh: V-B 计算复杂度比较

blocks.en: Table III compares SRCWDNet with eleven large-scale CNN, transformer and hybrid models. Unlike the lightweight models (MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50) typically used as efficiency baselines, this comparison set consists of extra-large backbones—VGG19, Wide ResNet-101-2, RegNetY-32GF, Swin-Large, ConvNeXt-Large/XLarge, CoAtNet-3, BEiT-Large, ViT-L/16, ViT-H/14, and EfficientNetV2-XL—all of which substantially exceed SRCWDNet’s parameter count and FLOPs. Although the backbone of SRCWDNet is of medium to heavy computational complexity, the additional relational-reasoning modules introduce only a small increase in computational demands, resulting in a markedly better efficiency than this category of extra-large models, with 3–6 × \times fewer parameters and up to 10 × \times fewer FLOPs, and similar multi-label classification results.
blocks.zh: 表三将SRCWDNet与11个大型CNN,变压器和混合型号进行比较. 与通常用作效率基线的轻量级模型(MobileNetV2, ExecutiveNet-B0, ResNet-50)不同的是,这一比较集由超大型骨干-VGG19, Wide ResNet-101-2, RegNetY-32GF, Swin-Large, ConvNeXt-Large/XLarge, CoAtNet-3, BeiT-L/16, ViT-H/14, 和 ecutiveNetV2-XL 组成,它们都大大超过了SRCWDNet的参数计数和FLOP。 虽然SRCWDNet的骨干是中到重计算复杂度,但额外的关系推理模块只引入了微小的计算需求,导致效率明显高于这一类超大型模型,参数减少3–6××××次,FLOP减少10×××次,类似多标签分类结果.

blocks.en: V-C Comparative Analysis with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: V-C 与最新方法的比较分析

blocks.en: Table IV compares the classification performance of the proposed SRCWDNet on the MLRSNet and China-MAS-50k multi-label remote sensing datasets with several state-of-the-art baselines. Compared with all six baseline models, the model achieves 98.93% accuracy on MLRSNet, outperforming CNN-based models like AlexNet (93.40%), VGG16 (94.63%) and ResNet50 (96.27%) and more recent efficient (95.39%) and transformer (95.81% and 96.62%) models. The steady margin over both convolutional and attention-based competitors shows that the Cross-Window Attention and Dual Label-Graph modules complement each other by learning better local-global and label-relational cues, respectively, which single-backbone architectures fail to discover with pure attention without explicit label reasoning. On the harder China-MAS-50k, SRCWDNet achieves 96.53% accuracy, well outperforming classical machine learning competitors such as Random Forest (35.26%) and XGBoost (40.29%), CNN models Inception-v3 (65.83%) and VGG19 (69.38%), and the top two deep learning baselines, ResNeXt-101 (74.00%) and DenseNet-169 (78.00%).

SRCWDNet shows a high mean average precision (AP) of 0.958 on MLRSNet and 0.918 on China-MAS-50k; both datasets maintain precision above 0.9 when recall is not too high, but precision drops as soon as recall goes beyond around 80%, indicating the challenge of correctly identifying the rare, long-tailed classes at high recall rates.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed a novel framework for multi-label remote sensing scene classification, namely SRCWDNet, which combines Cross-Window Attention, Dual Label-Graph reasoning and a Neural Classifier Chain into a trainable pipeline. Through extensive experiments on MLRSNet and China-MAS-50k, the results are consistently strong (98.93% and 96.53% accuracy, respectively), surpassing the existing CNN- and transformer-based baselines and explicitly modeling label co-occurrence and sequential dependencies that were largely ignored by prior methods. The larger difference seen in the performance on the China-MAS-50k test sets demonstrates the advantage of adapting to class imbalance in the presence of related labels. Future work will involve a lightweight backbone for more computational efficiency, extension to other multi-label RS benchmarks, and calibration-aware relational reasoning with noisy or missing label supervision.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一个关于多标签遥感场景分类的新框架,即SRCWDNet,将跨窗口注意力、双标签-图形推理和神经分类链结合到一个可训练的管道中。 通过对MLRSNet和China-MAS-50k的广泛实验,结果一直很强(分别为98.93%和96.53%的精确度),超过了现有的基于CNN和变压器的基线,并明确模拟标签的共聚性和相继依赖性,而以前的方法基本上忽视了这些特性。 在China-MAS-50k测试集上的性能差异较大,表明在存在相关标签的情况下适应阶级不平衡的优势. 未来工作将涉及提高计算效率的轻量级主干,扩展至其他多标签的RS基准,以及校准-意识关系推理与吵闹或缺失的标签监督.
